BEN-UI-001.scenario: Check that the Beneficiary List screen shows its subtitle, search box, buttons, all eight columns and the 'Showing N beneficiaries' count.
steps: Open Beneficiary List from the side menu.
Check the subtitle 'Payees registered with the bank' is shown.
Check the search box shows the hint 'Search by code or name…'.
Check the Reset Filters and Add Beneficiary buttons are visible.
Check the table has the columns Code, Name, Bank, Account, IFSC, Registration, Status, Added.
Compare the number of rows on page 1 with the 'Showing N beneficiaries' count.
BEN-UI-001.expected: All controls and the eight columns are shown. Page 1 shows as many rows as the 'Showing N' count, up to 25 per page.

BEN-UI-002.scenario: Verify that the Beneficiary List menu entry opens the /beneficiaries page.
steps: Open Beneficiary List from the side menu.
Check where the Beneficiary List menu link points.
Check the address in the browser bar.
BEN-UI-002.expected: The menu link points to /beneficiaries and the browser address ends with /beneficiaries.

BEN-UI-003.scenario: Check that the Account column shows only the last four digits of every account number.
BEN-UI-003.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Look at the Account column for every row on the page.
Look through the whole table for any full account number (9 to 18 digits in a row).
BEN-UI-003.expected: Every account is masked (for example ****1234, or '—' when empty) and no full account number appears anywhere in the table.

BEN-UI-004.scenario: Check that every row shows a known Registration label.
BEN-UI-004.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Read the Registration value for every row on the page.
BEN-UI-004.test_data: Allowed labels: Registered, Sent to bank, Send failed, Refused by bank, Not sent
BEN-UI-004.expected: Every row shows one of the allowed Registration labels; no unknown values appear.

BEN-UI-005.scenario: Check that searching an exact beneficiary code lists that beneficiary.
BEN-UI-005.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Note the code of the first beneficiary in the list.
Type that code in the search box and press Enter.
BEN-UI-005.test_data: Code of the first beneficiary in the list (e.g. EX000056)
BEN-UI-005.expected: The searched beneficiary appears in the results.

BEN-UI-006.scenario: Check that searching part of a name lists only matching beneficiaries.
BEN-UI-006.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Take the first 4 letters of the first word of the first beneficiary's name.
Type those letters in the search box and press Enter.
Check the names (and codes) in the results.
BEN-UI-006.test_data: First 4 letters of an existing name (e.g. 'QA A' from 'QA Auto ...')
BEN-UI-006.expected: At least one row is shown, and the results contain the search text in the name (or in the code).

BEN-UI-007.sub_module: Beneficiary List – Search and Reset Filters
BEN-UI-007.scenario: Check that a search with no match shows an empty list and Reset Filters brings the full list back.
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen and note the 'Showing N beneficiaries' count.
Type a text that matches no beneficiary in the search box and press Enter.
Check the count.
Click Reset Filters.
Check the search box and the count again.
BEN-UI-007.expected: The search shows 'Showing 0 beneficiaries'. After Reset Filters the search box is empty and the count returns to the original total.

BEN-UI-008.scenario: Check that SQL or script text typed into the search box does not cause an error, run any script or return unrelated rows.
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Type the attack text into the search box and press Enter.
Watch for any pop-up (alert) box.
Check the page for words like 'SQL', 'syntax error', 'exception' or 'stack trace'.
Check the rows returned.
BEN-UI-008.test_data: Run once for each: ' OR '1'='1 | admin'-- | " OR ""=" | ') OR ('1'='1 | 1 OR 1=1 | | "> |
BEN-UI-008.expected: No pop-up appears, no server error text is shown, and only rows whose name or code really contain the text are listed (normally none).

BEN-UI-009.scenario: Check that clicking a beneficiary code opens the details panel with all its fields and the Check status button.
BEN-UI-009.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Click the code of the first beneficiary.
Check the fields shown in the details panel (Payee and 'With the bank' sections).
Check the Beneficiary code value and the Check status button.
BEN-UI-009.test_data: Code of the first beneficiary in the list
BEN-UI-009.expected: The panel shows Beneficiary code, Name, Account, IFSC, Status with us, Added and Registration. The code matches the clicked code, the panel is described as 'Beneficiary code <code>', and the Check status button is visible.

BEN-UI-010.scenario: Check that the details panel shows the account number masked (last 4 digits only).
BEN-UI-010.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Click the code of the first beneficiary.
Look at the Account value in the details panel.
BEN-UI-010.expected: The Account value is masked, showing only the last four digits (for example ****1234).

BEN-UI-011.sub_module: Beneficiary details panel – Block / Unblock button
BEN-UI-011.scenario: Check that the Block or Unblock button is offered only when the beneficiary's status is ACTIVE or BLOCKED.
BEN-UI-011.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
For each of the first 4 beneficiaries, note the Status and click the code.
Check whether a Block or Unblock button is shown in the details panel.
Close the panel and move to the next beneficiary.
BEN-UI-011.test_data: First 4 beneficiaries in the list (any status)
BEN-UI-011.expected: Block/Unblock is shown for ACTIVE or BLOCKED beneficiaries and is not shown for any other status.

BEN-UI-012.scenario: Check that cancelling the 'Block this beneficiary?' confirmation leaves the beneficiary unchanged.
BEN-UI-012.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one ACTIVE beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Click the code of an ACTIVE beneficiary.
Click Block.
In the 'Block this beneficiary?' box, click Cancel.
Check the buttons in the details panel.
BEN-UI-012.test_data: First ACTIVE beneficiary in the list
BEN-UI-012.expected: The beneficiary is not blocked; the Block button is still shown.

BEN-UI-013.sub_module: Beneficiary details panel – Block and Unblock
BEN-UI-013.scenario: Verify that a beneficiary can be blocked (with confirmation) and then unblocked back to ACTIVE.
BEN-UI-013.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one ACTIVE beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped). This changes real shared data briefly; the original ACTIVE state is always restored.
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Click the code of an ACTIVE beneficiary.
Click Block, then click 'Block beneficiary' in the confirmation box.
Check the Unblock button appears and 'Status with us' shows BLOCKED.
Click Unblock.
Check the Block button appears again and 'Status with us' shows ACTIVE.
BEN-UI-013.test_data: First ACTIVE beneficiary in the list
BEN-UI-013.expected: After Block, status is BLOCKED and Unblock is offered. After Unblock, status is back to ACTIVE and Block is offered.

BEN-UI-014.scenario: Verify that Check status on an ACTIVE beneficiary asks the bank and updates the 'Last checked' time.
BEN-UI-014.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one ACTIVE beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped). A real status enquiry is sent to the bank.
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Click the code of an ACTIVE beneficiary.
Click Check status.
Wait for the bank's answer.
Look for the 'Last checked ...' line in the panel.
BEN-UI-014.test_data: First ACTIVE beneficiary in the list
BEN-UI-014.expected: The bank enquiry completes without a server error (no 5xx) and a 'Last checked ...' line is shown in the details panel.

BEN-UI-015.scenario: Check that the details panel closes with the X (Close) button and with the Escape key.
BEN-UI-015.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped).
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Click the code of the first beneficiary to open the details panel.
Close the panel using the method for this run (X button or Escape key).
BEN-UI-015.test_data: Run 1: Close (X) button | Run 2: Escape key
BEN-UI-015.expected: The details panel closes in both cases.

BEN-UI-016.sub_module: Beneficiary details panel – Check status error
BEN-UI-016.scenario: Check that when the bank cannot answer a status check, the user sees a clear error message.
BEN-UI-016.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped). The bank status-check reply is simulated as a failure (HTTP 502, UPSTREAM_ERROR), so the real bank is not called.
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen.
Click the code of the first beneficiary.
Click Check status.
Wait up to 8 seconds for a message on screen.
BEN-UI-016.test_data: Simulated bank reply: HTTP 502, message 'QA: the bank did not answer', code UPSTREAM_ERROR
BEN-UI-016.expected: The message 'QA: the bank did not answer' is shown to the user instead of nothing happening.

BEN-UI-020.scenario: Check that the Add beneficiary form shows all seven fields with their labels, plus Cancel and Register with bank buttons.
BEN-UI-020.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Check each field and its label is visible.
Check the Cancel button is visible.
Check the Register with bank button is enabled.
BEN-UI-020.test_data: Fields: Beneficiary code, Beneficiary name, Account number, Confirm account number, IFSC, Mobile number, Email address
BEN-UI-020.expected: All seven fields are shown with the correct labels; Cancel is visible and Register with bank is enabled.

BEN-UI-021.sub_module: Add Beneficiary form – Mandatory / optional markers
BEN-UI-021.scenario: Check that only Mobile number is marked optional and the Email address hint says 'Required.'
BEN-UI-021.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Read the label of each field.
Read the hint text under Email address.
BEN-UI-021.test_data: Mandatory: Beneficiary name, Account number, Confirm account number, IFSC, Email address. Optional: Mobile number
BEN-UI-021.expected: Mobile number is labelled '(optional)'; no mandatory field is labelled optional; the form shows 'Required.' for Email.

BEN-UI-022.scenario: Check that the beneficiary code is issued by the system in the right format and cannot be edited.
BEN-UI-022.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Wait for the Beneficiary code field to be filled automatically.
Check the code format.
Click into the Beneficiary code field and type 'X9'.
Check the code value again.
BEN-UI-022.expected: A code is filled in automatically (letters, digits, '-' or '_', up to 50 characters). The field is read-only and typing does not change the code.

BEN-UI-023.scenario: Check that a different beneficiary code is issued every time the form is opened.
BEN-UI-023.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary and note the code.
Click Cancel.
Repeat two more times (three openings in total).
Compare the three codes.
BEN-UI-023.expected: All three codes are different; no code is reused.

BEN-UI-024.scenario: Check that a newly issued code does not already belong to an existing beneficiary.
BEN-UI-024.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary and note the issued code.
Click Cancel.
Search the list for that code.
BEN-UI-024.test_data: The code just issued by the form
BEN-UI-024.expected: The search shows 'Showing 0 beneficiaries' – the code is not used by any existing beneficiary.

BEN-UI-025.sub_module: Add Beneficiary form – Closing the form
BEN-UI-025.scenario: Check that closing a filled form with Cancel, X or Escape does not register anything.
BEN-UI-025.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Close the form using the method for this run (Cancel, X button or Escape key).
Check that no registration request was sent.
BEN-UI-025.test_data: Valid 'QA Auto' beneficiary data. Run 1: Cancel | Run 2: Close (X) | Run 3: Escape key
BEN-UI-025.expected: The form closes and no create request is sent in any of the three cases.

BEN-UI-030.scenario: Check that submitting the empty form is refused with the beneficiary name message.
BEN-UI-030.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Leave all fields empty.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-030.expected: The message 'The beneficiary name is required.' is shown, the form stays open and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-031.scenario: Check that leaving any one mandatory field empty blocks registration with the right message.
BEN-UI-031.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data except the field for this run.
Leave that field empty.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-031.test_data: Run once per empty field: Beneficiary name | Account number | Confirm account number | IFSC | Email address
BEN-UI-031.expected: The matching message is shown ('The beneficiary name is required.' / 'The account number must be 9 to 18 digits.' / 'The two account numbers do not match.' / 'The IFSC must be 11 characters: four letters, a zero, then six letters or digits.' / 'A valid email address is required') and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-032.scenario: Check that a mandatory field filled with spaces only is treated as empty.
BEN-UI-032.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Replace the field for this run with spaces only.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-032.test_data: Beneficiary name: 5 spaces | Email address: 3 spaces | IFSC: 3 spaces
BEN-UI-032.expected: The field's required/format message is shown (name, email or IFSC message) and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-033.scenario: Verify that the form can be submitted with Mobile number left blank.
BEN-UI-033.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all mandatory fields with valid data.
Leave Mobile number empty.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-033.test_data: Valid 'QA Auto' data, Mobile number blank
BEN-UI-033.expected: The form closes, one registration request is sent, and it does not include a mobile number.

BEN-UI-034.scenario: Verify that every field is sent to the system exactly as entered.
BEN-UI-034.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary and note the issued code.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Click Register with bank.
Check the data that was sent.
BEN-UI-034.test_data: Name 'QA Auto <first> <last>', 14-digit account (same in confirm), IFSC e.g. SBIN0000001 / HDFC0000001 / ICIC0000001, 10-digit mobile starting with 9, test email
BEN-UI-034.expected: The form closes and exactly one request is sent containing the issued code, name, account number, IFSC, mobile and email exactly as typed.

BEN-UI-035.scenario: Check that a mobile number, when entered, must be exactly 10 digits.
BEN-UI-035.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Enter the invalid mobile number for this run.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-035.test_data: 98765 (5 digits) | 987654321 (9 digits) | 98765432101 (11 digits) | abcdefghij (letters) | +919876543210 (with country code)
BEN-UI-035.expected: The message 'The mobile number must be 10 digits.' is shown and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-036.scenario: Check that badly formed email addresses are refused.
BEN-UI-036.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Enter the invalid email for this run.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-036.test_data: abc | abc@ | abc@x | a b@x.com | @x.com | abc@@x.com
BEN-UI-036.expected: The message 'A valid email address is required' is shown and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-040.scenario: Check that account numbers of exactly 9 and 18 digits (the limits) are accepted.
BEN-UI-040.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Enter an account number of the length for this run in both Account number and Confirm account number.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-040.expected: The form closes and the account number is sent exactly as entered.

BEN-UI-041.scenario: Check that an account number shorter than 9 digits, longer than 18 digits, or without digits is refused.
BEN-UI-041.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Enter the account number for this run in both Account number and Confirm account number.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-041.expected: The message 'The account number must be 9 to 18 digits.' is shown and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-042.scenario: Check that an account number containing letters, symbols or dashes is refused and not silently cleaned.
BEN-UI-042.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Enter the account number for this run in both Account number and Confirm account number.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-042.expected: The message 'The account number must be 9 to 18 digits.' is shown and nothing is sent (the form must not strip the extra characters and send a different number).

BEN-UI-043.sub_module: Add Beneficiary form – Confirm account number
BEN-UI-043.scenario: Check that any difference between Account number and Confirm account number is refused.
BEN-UI-043.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Change Confirm account number as described for this run.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-043.test_data: Last digit changed | First digit changed | One digit short | One extra digit | Last two digits swapped
BEN-UI-043.expected: The message 'The two account numbers do not match.' is shown and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-044.sub_module: Add Beneficiary form – Confirm account number
BEN-UI-044.scenario: Verify that matching Account number and Confirm account number are accepted.
BEN-UI-044.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data, typing the same account number in both account fields.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-044.test_data: Same 14-digit account number in both fields
BEN-UI-044.expected: The form closes and one registration request is sent.

BEN-UI-045.sub_module: Add Beneficiary form – Confirm account number
BEN-UI-045.scenario: Check that pasting into Confirm account number is blocked so the number must be retyped.
BEN-UI-045.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Copy an account number to the clipboard.
Click into Confirm account number and press Ctrl+V.
Check the field value and its hint text.
BEN-UI-045.expected: The field stays empty after paste, and its hint text contains 'do not paste'.

BEN-UI-046.sub_module: Add Beneficiary form – Account number fields
BEN-UI-046.scenario: Check that both account number fields switch off browser auto-fill and use a numeric keypad.
BEN-UI-046.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Inspect the Account number field settings.
Inspect the Confirm account number field settings.
BEN-UI-046.expected: Both fields have browser auto-complete turned off and open a numeric keypad on mobile devices.

BEN-UI-050.scenario: Check that an IFSC not in the format 4 letters + '0' + 6 letters/digits (11 characters) is refused.
BEN-UI-050.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Enter the invalid IFSC for this run.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-050.test_data: HDFC000123 (10 chars) | HDFC00012345 (12 chars) | HDFCX001234 (5th char not 0) | HDFC1001234 (5th char 1) | HDF0001234 (3 letters) | 1234567890A (starts with digits) | HDFC0-01234 (dash) | HDFC 001234 (space)
BEN-UI-050.expected: The message 'The IFSC must be 11 characters: four letters, a zero, then six letters or digits.' is shown and nothing is sent.

BEN-UI-051.scenario: Verify that an IFSC typed in lower case is shown and sent in upper case.
BEN-UI-051.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data, typing the IFSC in lower case.
Check the IFSC field shows upper case.
Click Register with bank.
BEN-UI-051.expected: The field shows SBIN0000001, the form closes and the IFSC is sent in upper case.

BEN-UI-060.sub_module: Add Beneficiary form – Register end to end
BEN-UI-060.scenario: Verify that a fully valid beneficiary is registered, appears in the list with a masked account, and shows correct details.
BEN-UI-060.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. This creates one real 'QA Auto' beneficiary on UAT and sends it to the bank.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary and note the issued code.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Click Register with bank and wait for the reply.
Search the list for the code.
Check the Account and Registration columns of the new row.
Click the code and check Name, IFSC, Email, Mobile and Account in the details panel.
BEN-UI-060.test_data: Name 'QA Auto <first> <last>', 14-digit account, IFSC SBIN0000001 / HDFC0000001 / ICIC0000001, 10-digit mobile, test email
BEN-UI-060.expected: Registration succeeds (HTTP 200/201) and the form closes. The new beneficiary is listed with the account masked to the last 4 digits and a known Registration label. The details show the entered name, IFSC, email and mobile, the account is masked, and the full account number appears nowhere on the page.

BEN-UI-061.scenario: Check that registering with a code that already exists is refused and the form issues a fresh code.
BEN-UI-061.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one beneficiary exists (otherwise the test is skipped). The real create request is sent, but its code is swapped for an existing beneficiary's code.
steps: Open the Beneficiary List screen; note the first beneficiary's code and the total count.
Click Add Beneficiary and note the issued code.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Click Register with bank (the request carries the existing code).
Read the message in the form and check the code field.
Click Cancel, reload the list and check the total count.
BEN-UI-061.test_data: Code of the first existing beneficiary; valid 'QA Auto' data
BEN-UI-061.expected: The system refuses (HTTP 400/409/422, code DUPLICATE_REFERENCE). The form shows 'That beneficiary code is already in use, so a new one has been issued.' and a new code different from both the old and existing ones is filled in. The list total is unchanged.

BEN-UI-070.scenario: Check that script text typed into Beneficiary name is never run in the browser.
BEN-UI-070.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data, entering the script text as the Beneficiary name.
Click Register with bank.
Watch for any pop-up (alert) box.
BEN-UI-070.expected: No pop-up appears. If the form sends the request, the name is sent as plain text exactly as typed.

BEN-UI-071.scenario: Check that the typed account number is not saved in the browser's local or session storage.
BEN-UI-071.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Beneficiary List screen is open. The create request is intercepted so no real beneficiary is registered.
steps: Click Add Beneficiary.
Fill all fields with valid data.
Click Register with bank and wait for the form to close.
Inspect the browser's local storage and session storage.
BEN-UI-071.test_data: Valid 'QA Auto' data with a 14-digit account number
BEN-UI-071.expected: The full account number is not found in local storage or session storage.
